context_for_next_testing_agent: Biometric fingerprint login thoroughly tested. Key findings: 1) Biometric button appears only when both biometricEnabled=true AND biometricMobile is set in localStorage, 2) OTP login saves biometricMobile and biometricPatientName to localStorage, 3) biometricEnabled/biometricAvailable are set based on WebAuthn availability (not available in headless browser), 4) Error handling works correctly with appropriate toast messages, 5) Fallback to OTP login works after biometric failure, 6) Skip button works correctly. Note: Actual fingerprint prompt cannot be tested in headless browser but error handling paths verified.
